SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN 100 * (SELECT AVG(Consumption) FROM yearmonth WHERE Segment = 'SME' AND Date LIKE '2013%' AND Currency = 'EUR') / (SELECT AVG(Consumption) FROM yearmonth WHERE Segment = 'SME' AND Date LIKE '2012%' AND Currency = 'EUR') - 100
    WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN 100 * (SELECT AVG(Consumption) FROM yearmonth WHERE Segment = 'LAM' AND Date LIKE '2013%' AND Currency = 'EUR') / (SELECT AVG(Consumption) FROM yearmonth WHERE Segment = 'LAM' AND Date LIKE '2012%' AND Currency = 'EUR') - 100
    ELSE 100 * (SELECT AVG(Consumption) FROM yearmonth WHERE Segment = 'KAM' AND Date LIKE '2013%' AND Currency = 'EUR') / (SELECT AVG(Consumption) FROM yearmonth WHERE Segment = 'KAM' AND Date LIKE '2012%' AND Currency = 'EUR') - 100
  END AS BiggestIncrease,
  CASE 
    WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN 100 * (SELECT MIN(Consumption) FROM yearmonth WHERE Segment = 'SME' AND Date LIKE '2013%' AND Currency = 'EUR') / (SELECT MIN(Consumption) FROM yearmonth WHERE Segment = 'SME' AND Date LIKE '2012%' AND Currency = 'EUR') - 100
    WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN 100 * (SELECT MIN(Consumption) FROM yearmonth WHERE Segment = 'LAM' AND Date LIKE '2013%' AND Currency = 'EUR') / (SELECT MIN(Consumption) FROM yearmonth WHERE Segment = 'LAM' AND Date LIKE '2012%' AND Currency = 'EUR') - 100
    ELSE 100 * (SELECT MIN(Consumption) FROM yearmonth WHERE Segment = 'KAM' AND Date LIKE '2013%' AND Currency = 'EUR') / (SELECT MIN(Consumption) FROM yearmonth WHERE Segment = 'KAM' AND Date LIKE '2012%' AND Currency = 'EUR') - 100
  END AS LowestIncrease
FROM customers

SELECT Segment, 
       (CONSUMPTION_2013 - CONSUMPTION_2012) / CONSUMPTION_2012 AS big_percentage_increase, 
       (CONSUMPTION_2012 - CONSUMPTION_2013) / CONSUMPTION_2012 AS small_percentage_increase 
FROM (SELECT c.Segment, 
             SUM(CASE WHEN ym.Date LIKE '%/%/2012' THEN t.Consumption END) AS CONSUMPTION_2012, 
             SUM(CASE WHEN ym.Date LIKE '%/%/2013' THEN t.Consumption END) AS CONSUMPTION_2013 
      FROM customers c 
      JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID 
      JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID 
      WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR' AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM') 
      GROUP BY c.Segment) AS subquery

SELECT 
    Segment, 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2013 THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2012 THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2012 THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END), 0) AS Increase,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2013 THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2012 THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END)) / 
    (SELECT MAX(Increase) FROM (SELECT 
        (SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2013 THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2012 THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END)) / 
        NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2012 THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END), 0) AS Increase
        FROM yearmonth y
        WHERE Currency = 'EUR' AND y.Date BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2012-12-31'
        GROUP BY Segment) AS subquery) AS LowIncrease
FROM yearmonth y
WHERE Currency = 'EUR' AND y.Date BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2013-12-31'
GROUP BY Segment

SELECT 
  Segment, 
  (SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(Date) = 2013 THEN Consumption END) - SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(Date) = 2012 THEN Consumption END)) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(Date) = 2012 AND Currency = 'EUR' THEN Consumption END) AS Increase, 
  (SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(Date) = 2012 THEN Consumption END) - SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(Date) = 2013 THEN Consumption END)) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(Date) = 2013 AND Currency = 'EUR' THEN Consumption END) AS Decrease
FROM yearmonth
WHERE YEAR(Date) IN (2012, 2013)
GROUP BY Segment

SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN 100 * (SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(Date) = 2013 THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(Date) = 2012 THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END)) / 
    SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(Date) = 2012 THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END)
    WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN 100 * (SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(Date) = 2013 THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(Date) = 2012 THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END)) / 
    SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(Date) = 2012 THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 100 * (SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(Date) = 2013 THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(Date) = 2012 THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END)) / 
    SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(Date) = 2012 THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END)
  END AS biggest_increase,
  CASE 
    WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN 100 * (SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(Date) = 2013 THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(Date) = 2012 THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END)) / 
    SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(Date) = 2012 THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END)
    WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN 100 * (SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(Date) = 2013 THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(Date) = 2012 THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END)) / 
    SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(Date) = 2012 THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 100 * (SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(Date) = 2013 THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(Date) = 2012 THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END)) / 
    SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(Date) = 2012 THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END)
  END AS lowest_increase
FROM yearmonth
WHERE Currency = 'EUR' AND YEAR(Date) IN (2012, 2013)
